SELECT c.cart_id, c.member_id, c.guest_id, c.product_id, c.weight_gram, c.quantity, c.created_at, c.updated_at, p.product_name, p.product_image, p.origin_cd, pp.price_per_kg, (pp.price_per_kg::BIGINT * c.weight_gram / 1000) AS unit_price, (pp.price_per_kg::BIGINT * c.weight_gram / 1000 * c.quantity) AS total_price FROM cart c INNER JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT price_per_kg FROM product_price WHERE product_id = c.product_id AND use_yn = 'Y' AND base_date <= #{baseDate} ORDER BY base_date DESC, price_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) pp ON TRUE WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y'
AND c.member_id = #{memberId}
AND c.guest_id = #{guestId} AND c.member_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.cart_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart ( member_id, guest_id, product_id, weight_gram, quantity ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{guestId}, #{productId}, #{weightGram}, #{quantity} )
